title: Understanding Prior Bias and Choice Paralysis in Transformer-based Language Representation Models through Four Experimental Probes

bias_targets.methodology: Applying prompt-based and choice-based confusion probes (No-Question, Wrong-Question, and No-Right-Answer) to multiple-choice NLU benchmarks to evaluate if the model relies on surface similarities or baseline option probabilities rather than actual reasoning when the correct answer or relevant prompt is removed.

Expanding the set of candidate choices with additional incorrect options using random and heuristic sampling to measure whether the model's confidence in the correct candidate significantly diminishes as more options are introduced.
